content: हंसः [हस्-अच्-पृषो˚ वर्णागमः] (said to be derived from हस्; <ab>cf.</ab> भवेद्वर्णागमाद् हंसः <ls>Sk.</ls>) .²1 A swan, goose, duck; हंसाः संप्रति पाण्डवा इव वनादज्ञातचर्यां गताः <ls>Mk. 5. 6</ls>; न शोभते सभामध्ये हंसमध्ये बको यथा <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>R. 17. 25</ls>. (The description of this bird, as given by Sanskrit writers, is more poetical than real; he is described as forming the vehicle of the god Brahman, and as ready to fly towards the Mānasa lake at the approach of rains; <ab>cf.</ab> मानस. According to a very general poetical convention he is represented as being gifted with the peculiar power of separating milk from water {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} सारं ततो ग्राह्यमपास्य फल्गु हंसो यथा क्षीरमिवाम्बुमध्यात् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; हंसो हि क्षीरमादत्ते तन्मिश्रा वर्जयत्यपः <ls>Ś. 6. 28</ls>; नीरक्षीरविवेके हंसालस्यं त्वमेव तनुषे चेत् . विश्वस्मिन्नधुनान्यः कुलव्रतं पालयिष्यति कः <ls>Bv. 1. 13</ls>; see <ls>Bh. 2. 18</ls> also). .²2 The Supreme Soul, Brahman. .²3 The individual soul (जीवात्मन्); प्रीणीहि हंसशरणं विरमक्रमेण <ls>Bhāg. 4. 29. 56</ls>. .²4 One of the vital airs. .²5 The sun; हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषत् <ls>Kaṭh. 2. 5. 2</ls>; उषसि हंसमुदीक्ष्य हिमानिकाविपुलवागुरया परियन्त्रितम् <ls>Rām. Ch. 4. 91</ls>. .²6 Śiva. .²7 Viṣṇu. .²8 Kāmadeva. .²9 An unambitious monarch. .²10 An ascetic of a particular order; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 12. 43</ls>. .²11 A spiritual preceptor; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 9. 18</ls>. .²12 One free from malice, a pure person. .²13 A mountain. .²14 Envy, malice. .²15 A buffalo. .²16 A horse. .²17 A particular incantation; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²18 The best of its kind (at the end of a compound; <ab>cf.</ab> कविहंस); <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²19 A temple of a particular form. .²20 Silver. --{%a.%} .²1 moving, going (गतिमान्); नवद्वारं पुरं गत्वा हंसो हि नियतो वशी <ls>Mb. 12. 239. 31</ls> (see <ab>com.</ab>). .²2 Pure; हंसाय संयतगिरे निगमेश्वराय <ls>Bhāg. 12. 8. 47</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">6. 4. 26</ls>. .{@-साः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a tribe said to live in the Plakṣa-Dvīpa.
